chunks: "To give one sa' of dates in Zakat al-Fitrah is more beloved to me than to give one sa' of gold."

key_terms.اَلْفِطْرَةِ: Zakat al-Fitrah, the alms due at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.تَمْرٍ: dates, a staple food preferred here for Zakat al-Fitrah
key_terms.تِبْرٍ: gold in unminted or raw form
key_terms.صَاعًا: a sa', a recognized measure of volume used for obligatory charity

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام prefer to give in Zakat al-Fitrah?
ai.summary: This hadith states the preference of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام for giving dates as Zakat al-Fitrah rather than giving an equivalent measure of gold. It reflects a legal and devotional preference within the practice of Zakat al-Fitrah, highlighting the value of giving from staple food.
